normalizations: Outlined PDF: original.pdf has no text layer; every English line is a manual transcription from 300 dpi renders, kept as printed (source/intake.py names the physical page of each block).
Shared Manual IR: content.json is replayed through the shared flow renderer and shared components. No package class, inline style or plain table (prepared-document shared-style gate).

Print weights: bold print runs stay strong; headings keep print case. Printed bullet and number marks become lists; hollow-bullet items nest under their item. Subscripts (V_oc, LiFePO4) stay subscript.
Line ends inside a paragraph are wraps; the print's explicit line breaks inside one block stay line breaks.

Figures are source panels cropped just inside the print's panel frame (the decorative frame is drawn by the shared theme); words drawn in the art stay in the art and the alt text carries printed sentences. Notes and cautions the print boxes inside a panel are shared callout strips under the figure.
Cover (p1) and table of contents (p3) are not Web content; the back cover (p17) becomes the closing contact section without its phone/mail/web pictograms.

en.caption_text: Warning and Caution Symbols. Must read to alert individuals to potential hazards or risks.
Read the user manual before operation.

This symbol indicates that the product shall not be disposed of as household waste, and should be delivered to a designated collection facility for recycling. Proper disposal and recycling can help protect the environment. For more information about the disposal and recycling of this product, contact your local community, disposal service, or dealer.
Keep the product away from fire.
This symbol indicates that a lithium-ion (Li-ion) battery is inside the product and should be disposed of or recycled properly.
